article.question: Does using Fast Cleaner automatically remove photo locations?

source.title: Understand, find and edit photo locations
source.fact: Google documents location estimates based on landmarks and other photos. Removing one metadata field does not remove visual clues or every service-level location record.

article.comparison: Three separate places location information can appear
article.claim_scope: Official guidance supports platform facts. Fast Cleaner descriptions rely on its developer disclosures and existing store/product assets; no independent performance or security test is claimed.
